"Retard! Retard!" is just on Airbus planes. It happens about 30' off the ground, and is the signal to arrest the descent (i.e. flare) and close the throttles.

The thrust reversers are disabled until touchdown. Once the "weight on wheels" switch is tripped, the reversers are unlocked and available for use, but are always manually selected.

That same switch also automatically deploys the spoilers, provided they were armed prior to landing.
